title: Recruiting coordinator daily scratchpad - 2026-03-18
content:
Quick notes / today priorities (hi-level)
- block scheduling windows, follow-ups, interview prep, debriefs

Morning triage (before 10:30)
- [ ] Check candidate pipelines for today: surface any blockers (tech screen no-shows, missing take-home)
- [ ] Confirm interviewer availability for 3 onsite loops (SRE, infra eng) - ping Marcus if gaps
- [ ] Send reminder to hiring mgrs for debrief forms after each loop

Today candidate follow-ups (send short status + next steps)
1) Maria Gomez (Senior SRE) - took home code test submitted 03/16
   - Action: send quick note to acknowledge receipt + ETA for review (2 business days)
   - Template: "Thanks Maria — got it, we’ll review and get back by Fri 03/20. Appreciate the quick turnaround!"
   - Notes: strong infra background; flagged for on-call experience question in loop

2) Jamal Thompson (Backend SWE) - scheduled phone screen 03/19 11:00 PT (timezone noted)
   - Action: confirm phone number + zoom link, add interviewer SDR in calendar
   - Quick checklist: resume in packet, take-home flagged? no, coding sample expected in loop

3) Priya Kapoor (Data Eng) - reschedule request (available 03/20 afternoon)
   - Action: propose 3 slots (3:00p, 4:00p, 4:30p PT), cc recruiter Sofia
   - Note: hiring team prefers 4:00p slot if possible

4) Aaron Bell (Infrastructure PM) - whiteboard onsite invite sent, candidate asked for interview loop details
   - Action: email loop agenda + parking/logistics + interview kit link

Interview logistics (today/tomorrow)
- Onsite loop (Thu): arrival + room booking (Ops conf B), laptop check, badge requests to facilities
- Ensure interviewers have interview kit link (confluence:REC-Interview-Kit) and debrief form link in calendar invites
- Confirm Slack channel for real-time notes: #hiring-sre-2026

Time-blocks (my day)
- 09:00-10:00 triage + candidate follow-ups
- 10:00-11:30 scheduling (calendar + interviewer confirmations)
- 11:30-12:00 prep reminders + create interview packets
- 13:00-15:00 buffer for reschedules and ad-hoc requests
- 15:00-16:00 debriefs / writeups / update ATS

Templates/snippets to reuse
- Confirm slot message: "Thanks for the update — I’ve scheduled you for [DATE/TIME] PT. Zoom link in invite. Please reply if you need to change."
- No-show follow-up: "Hi [Name], we missed you for today’s screen — are you available to reschedule? If you prefer to withdraw, just let me know."

Open questions / blockers
- Hiring manager for Data Eng still hasn’t completed interviewer training (need Marcus to escalate)
- Facilities needs guest wifi pass for onsite (I submitted request yesterday, not confirmed)

Reminders to self
- Update ATS statuses after each debrief (set aside 30 min blocks)
- Add quick note to candidate profiles about timezone & windows to prefer (avoid back-and-forth)
- Draft short candidate experience survey to send after onsite (mini NPS + 2 quick questions)

Randoms / adhoc notes
- Check budget headcount spreadsheet for recruiting capacity Q2 (link in finance slack)
- Flag contract for external sourcer renewal in April

End-of-day checklist
- [ ] ATS statuses updated
- [ ] Interview packets uploaded to calendar invites
- [ ] Follow-ups sent (Maria, Priya, Jamal)
- [ ] Facilities + badge confirmed for onsite

-----
Notes to self (short-hand):
- prefer 3:30p PT as default for reschedules (keeps morning open)
- use short bullets in candidate messages, avoid long paragraphs
- check candidate timezone in profile before proposing times
